    <span class="hl-comment">@SuppressWarnings</span>(<span class="hl-str">&quot;unchecked&quot;</span>)

        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> UserCreatedData(

            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;id&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;email&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;website&quot;</span>),
